subject: Comparing groups: testing and estimating differences between two means, two proportions or several means, checking the assumptions, and reporting how big a difference is
outOfScope: The logic of a hypothesis test: hypotheses, p-values, significance levels, Type I and II errors, and statistical versus practical significance (see the Hypothesis testing pack)
Standard errors, the t-distribution and building confidence intervals (see the Sampling distributions pack); intervals for a difference in two means or proportions beyond naming them
Designing and reading product experiments: randomisation units, metrics, sample-size and power calculations, peeking, and corrections for many metrics (see the A/B testing pack)
Comparing counts across many categories, and chi-square tests (see the Categorical data pack)
Two-way and higher ANOVA, interactions, random effects, repeated-measures and mixed models
Formulas and derivations: pooled standard deviations, Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom, sums of squares and the studentized range
Nonparametric tests (Mann-Whitney, Wilcoxon, Kruskal-Wallis) and the F-test for two variances, beyond naming them
Effect sizes other than Cohen's d, such as eta-squared, correlation or odds ratios
Tooling: Minitab, R, Python and spreadsheet functions
